rows.description: 🍃 Organic Maps is a free Android & iOS offline maps app for more than 6M travelers, tourists, hikers, and cyclists. It uses crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data and is developed with love by the community. No ads, no tracking, no data collection, no crapware. Please donate to support the development!
Map sources for ATAK: satellite, topo, street, nautical, aeronautical and overlay maps, each tested the way ATAK loads tiles.
An open-source bike computer with GPS and ANT+ capabilities, based on the Raspberry Pi Zero (W, WH, 2 W) or the Compute Module Zero (CM0). It also includes offline maps and navigation.
A GPS bicycle speedometer that supports offline maps and track recording
